lines.displayLine: Well I’ll be damned. When they said Chicago was gonna send her finest, I didn’t expect them to send a her! Listen, lady, this isn’t some two timed co-ed city caper. Try not to stand in my way. If you’d like, maybe you can file the paperwork.
I.. uh… While I understand your hesitation towards my abilities, Sheriff. I assure you I’m perfectly capable of conducting a clean investigation.
Shooting a look at the sheriff  Hey, hey now, we’re all a big team stale chuckle. At the end of the day we all play for the same team … America.
